title: Single-Cell and Transcriptome Analysis of Periodontitis: Molecular Subtypes and Biomarkers Linked to Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Immunity.
summary: Four subtypes were identified; five biomarkers (BNIP3, FAHD1, UNG, CBR3 and SLC25A43) were validated by qPCR/IHC, with three significantly downregulated. Findings are limited to the analyzed samples and biomarker assays; non-invasive diagnostic utility remains unproven.
ai_technology: Five machine-learning algorithms prioritize biomarkers from periodontitis single-cell RNA-sequencing and transcriptomic data; consensus clustering identifies molecular subtypes.
organization: Department of Periodontology; Yunnan Key Laboratory of Stomatology
